description: This file implements an Active Record pattern for database interaction within a PHP project. It defines classes for managing database tables and records, including relationships, loading, saving, and caching mechanisms. The file serves as a core component of the ADOdb library for abstracting database operations in PHP.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_DB
classes.description: Represents a database connection and its associated tables for active record operations.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Table
classes.description: Represents metadata about a database table, including fields and relationships.

classes.name: ADODB_Active_Record
classes.description: Main class implementing Active Record functionality, including CRUD operations, relations, and metadata management.

methods.name: ADODB_SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Associates a database connection with an adapter index.

methods.name: UseDefaultValues
methods.description: Set or get the global default values for new active record instances.

methods.name: SetDatabaseAdapter
methods.description: Static method to assign database connection to a specific adapter index.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for the ADODB_Active_Record class, initializes the record with table info and database connection.

methods.name: hasMany
methods.description: Defines a one-to-many relationship with another active record.

methods.name: TableHasMany
methods.description: Static method to set a has-many relationship for a specified table.

methods.name: belongsTo
methods.description: Defines a belongs-to relationship with another record.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads a record from the database based on a where condition.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Persists the current record to the database, either inserting or updating.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the current record from the database.

methods.name: Find
methods.description: Performs a query to find records matching conditions.
